Q5643.reason: The son was an intended donee beneficiary, but under Restatement (Second) the parties may modify until rights vest by assent, suit, or reliance, and he learned of the deal only after payment.

Q5645.reason: AHA guidance targets about 100–120 compressions per minute; 80 is too slow and compressing as fast as possible reduces depth and recoil.

Q5649.reason: Catheter valves are avoided in the immediate post-operative period when free drainage and urine-output monitoring are required; sensation, patient choice, and no need to measure urine all favor a valve.
